sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager Town, who have won just once all season and are on a run of five defeats in their last six games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, a chance to close the gap on leaders Sandbach as both teams sit within two points of each other. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash, with both sides showing competitive recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in-form with three straight wins, welcome Wednesfield Community, who have won their last two but sit deeper in the standings. Bilston Town (sixth) travel to Foley Meir in what should be a close encounter between teams separated by just six points. Barnton host Shawbury United on Saturday; Shawbury are in serious trouble with six consecutive defeats. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a clash between struggling sides, while Crewe entertain Allscott Heath as two mid-lower teams meet. Widnes Town, bottom with just two points, travel to Brereton Social—another fixture that should favour the home side. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's poorest-performing teams. Finally, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening in a midweek fixture, a repeat meeting between sides currently occupying similar mid-to-lower table positions.
